label: Timeline
intent: The playhead scrubs to a new frame across the clip tracks. Light: the head launches along the ruler, crosses 12 and stops dead a little past its frame; its marks on the two tracks catch up in order (top track, then bottom) and everything settles. Strong: the head first pulls back, then sweeps faster and overshoots farther, rebounding twice before it settles, with the track marks arriving in order behind it. Ruler and clips never move; the preview reset fades it back.

playhead-guide-a.x.//: the track marks catch up in order
